# OpenCode Workbench (workbench-mcp)

> Open-source (MIT) MCP server + connector that clones the OpenCode workbench installation onto Linux machines — locally or over SSH — reproducing the same OpenCode config, MCP servers, agent skills, plugins, and Docker tooling. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode, VS Code and other MCP clients.

## Connect

- Local stdio server (no API key): `npx -y github:simonplmak-cloud/workbench`
- Glama listing: https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/simonplmak-cloud/workbench
- Context7 library ID: `/simonplmak-cloud/workbench`

## MCP tools (6)

- `workbench_info`: describe this server — repo, components by tier, optional MCP add-ons
- `inspect_target`: probe a machine — OS, arch, package manager, Node, Docker, OpenCode, home and npm-global paths
- `plan_clone`: diff the target against the profile → install / present / manual steps
- `apply_clone`: clone the profile + install missing components + write rendered config (idempotent)
- `verify_clone`: re-check config, env template, and every component's detection
- `install_component`: install a single component by id (e.g. `node`, `opencode`, `npm-mcps`, `skills`)

Every tool takes a `target`:

```json
{ "target": { "mode": "ssh", "host": "box", "user": "admin", "identityFile": "~/.ssh/id_ed25519" } }
```

`apply_clone` options: `components[]`, `workspace`, `profileUrl`, `skipRepo`, `dryRun`.
